name: base-blocked-unlock-pickup
task: Pick up the blocking ball and the key, in either order, unlock the door, and then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task requires picking up the target box, but no clause makes it happen. The only clause mentioning target_picked_up is the hard Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up), which is a rule alone and requires nothing; without an Existence, the machine can finish (u4) after just moving the blocker and getting the key. Add a hard Existence(target_picked_up) so the box pickup is required; the two hard Precedences on door_open and this Precedence then chain the blocker, key, door, and box, forcing blocker_moved, has_door_key, and door_open, so no other Existence clauses are needed.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(target_picked_up) hard makes the box pickup a goal, Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) puts unlocking before it, and the two Precedence clauses put blocker_moved and has_door_key before door_open in either order, which forces both; no redundant Existence clauses.
